description:
Save a new chart to the connected account from name, gender, birth date (Gregorian or lunar), optional birth time and birthplace; time zone and hemisphere come from the birthplace as in the app. Returns the chart_id.
Use when the user explicitly asks to save a chart; check list_saved_charts first to avoid duplicates. For another person the user must confirm consent (consent_attested); without it nothing is saved or cast.
Not for casting without saving (use cast_bazi_chart), reading (use get_saved_chart) or editing existing charts.
New charts return no pillars; read them with get_saved_chart.

birth_date.description: Birth date in the local calendar of the birthplace, YYYY-MM-DD: Gregorian by default; with calendar lunar, the Chinese lunar year, month (1-12) and day.

birth_time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, HH:mm. Omit if unknown; the chart is then marked as hour uncertain.

birthplace.description: Birthplace name as in the FateTell app, a city optionally with country, 1 to 60 characters. Not stored or logged by this server.

calendar.description: Default solar (Gregorian). Use lunar when the user gives a Chinese lunar birthday; the server converts it to Gregorian, so do not convert it yourself.

consent_attested.description: Required true when subject is other: the user confirms they have that person's permission.

display_name.description: Name for the chart, 1 to 20 characters, no line breaks or Markdown symbols.

gender.description: Determines whether the luck pillars run forward or backward.

lunar_leap_month.description: Default false. Only with calendar lunar: true when the birth was in a leap month, e.g. leap 4th month is month 04 with true.

subject.description: Whose chart this is, recorded for audit only. Default other. Every chart saved here is an additional chart; it never becomes the user's own primary chart.

name: create_saved_chart

engine_version.description: FateTell calculation engine version (package version + commit).

links.description: FateTell web pages for objects in this result, for citation. Only objects already present in the result are linked.

rel.description: Which FateTell page this is: chart, daily_fortune, luck_pillars or account.

url.description: Page in the FateTell web app for an object that appears in this result.

matched_existing.description: True when a chart with the same name and birth details already exists; that chart is returned and no new one is created.

moments.description: Calendar facts about this date: luck_pillar_change_in (value = months), solar_term_today, annual_clash (year branch clashes the natal year branch), birth_year_return (year pillar equals the natal year pillar), month_clash, energy_extreme (high or low energy), birthday_window (within 7 days of the birthday).

value.description: Only for luck_pillar_change_in: months until the next luck pillar starts.

notes.description: Codes for facts that qualify this result: hour_assumed (no birth time, 12:00 used), true_solar_skipped_no_longitude, southern_month_adjusted, palace_formula_lunar_javascript (life and body palaces follow the lunar-javascript formula), legacy_v0_chart, judgment_unavailable, chart_pending, truncated, lunar_converted (the birth date was given in the lunar calendar and converted to Gregorian).

paipan_version.description: Chart rule version. Charts computed now are always v1 (FateTell cross-region rules).

anyOf.description: The four pillars as stem-branch strings: year, month, day, hour.

day.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

hour.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

month.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

year.description: A stem-branch pair in Chinese characters, e.g. "丙午".

pillars.description: Null while the chart is still being computed.

resolved.description: Time zone and hemisphere FateTell resolved from the birthplace, and the Gregorian birth date saved.

birth_date.description: Gregorian birth date saved; converted from the lunar date when calendar is lunar.

title: Create saved chart
